messages.subject: StatET
parts:
Dear list,

Is it possible to use Deducer and the Plot Builder from within the
StatET plugin console?

When I call deducer() and select Plots, Plot Builder from the RGui
Console, it works fine and contains datasets that I previously
loaded. However, when I call deducer() and select Plot Builder from
within StatET, it opens the Plot Builder OK, but no datasets are
visible.

I saw a post on the StatET user group a few months back that there was
interest in extending the StatET plugin to integrate Deducer, so i'd
be interested to hear how that process is coming along.

Thanks
